uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-7316--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-7316--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

803-3413-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2411-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

206-215-850.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
206-215-850.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2448-5220-6900-7452.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2448-5220-6900-7452.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2231-2292-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-2292-4871-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

127-7117.description:
Cast Imps' Taunt with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, returning Imps' Taunt to your hand.
Repeat.

413-2366-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
413-2366-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Blasting Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat from step 5.

579-955-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-955-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1115-1402-2644-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1062-3487-5014-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3487-5014-5674.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

1636-1722-6625-6629.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1636-1722-6625-6629.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Rune-Sealed Wall by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2341-4050-6591.easyPrerequisites:
Squall is not your commander.
You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
2341-4050-6591.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Squall's ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Peregrine Dynamo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Peregrine Dynamo ability, copying Squall's trigger, with the new trigger targeting The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Squall's trigger, returning The Peregrine Dynamo from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

880-3534-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control at least one additional creature.
880-3534-4871.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2043-4050-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating 18 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.
1270-2043-4050-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

1116-3240-5670-6273.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-6273.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1987-2187-2239-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2187-2239-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Possessed Skaab.
When Ardent Elementalist and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-2239-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1393-4986-5034-5686--18.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Aether Channeler
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=1 by paying at most {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Aether Channeler
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

774-2653-3478.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2178-3143-3490-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature with one or more +1/+1 counters on it.
You control at least one other creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3143-3490-4871.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters among creatures you control, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

116-1430-2569.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Image is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirror Image do not have summoning sickness.
116-1430-2569.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Mirror Image.
Activate Mirror Image by tapping it.
When Mirror Image becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Mirror Image's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

235-4150-4179.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing creatures you control to get +1/+1 and gain infect until end of turn.
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent thirteen poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

350-466-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
350-466-2034.description:
Cast Beck by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Saproling Cluster by paying {1} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Beck triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

696-2751-2872-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Black Market has at least six charge counters on it.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Clever Conjurer.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
696-2751-2872-5200.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Black Market's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Black Market's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Black Market's trigger, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat from step 2.

573-1479-2638.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-2638.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1121-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
1121-4276.description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Mischievous Quanar's morph ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, turning it face up.
Mischievous Quanar triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mischievous Quanar by paying {3}{U}{U}, turning it face down.
Repeat from step 3.

65-717-2628-4310-4477.description:
Activate Blasted Landscape's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Blasted Landscape, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasted Landscape trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Greenwarden of Murasa.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, returning Blasted Landscape from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
